video_goal: Demonstrate how to build an interactive branching scenario using the Lesson Activity Builder in SMART Notebook 20.

outline_steps.visual_action: The cursor moves across the SMART Notebook 20 top toolbar and clicks the Lesson Activity Builder icon, which is shaped like a small space invader.
The Activity Builder template menu appears; the cursor scrolls down through the grid of colorful activity thumbnails.
The cursor hovers over and clicks a template thumbnail designed for branching or path-based scenarios.
The activity setup wizard opens. The cursor clicks into the 'Title' text field at the top and types in a title for the scenario.
The cursor clicks a blue 'Add Node' button, causing a new rectangular scenario box to pop up on the blank workspace.
The cursor clicks inside the new node, types a question prompt, and then clicks the 'Add Choice' plus icon twice to create two options.
The cursor clicks and drags a second rectangular node from the sidebar onto the main workspace, placing it to the right of the first node.
The cursor clicks a small circle next to 'Choice A' on the first node and drags a linking line to connect it to the second node.
The cursor drags a third node onto the workspace and draws another linking line from 'Choice B' on the first node to this third node.
The cursor moves to the bottom right of the wizard interface and clicks the 'Preview' button.
A preview overlay appears, displaying the first node's text prompt and two interactive choice buttons below it.
The cursor clicks the first choice button, and the preview instantly transitions to display the connected second node.
The cursor clicks the 'X' icon to close the preview, then clicks the green 'Finish' button at the bottom of the wizard.
The wizard closes, and the fully built branching scenario activity renders as an interactive element onto the main SMART Notebook 20 slide canvas.
